text.title: Scalloped hammerhead
text.nearby: A scalloped hammerhead swims nearby with its wide hammer head.
text.chasing: A scalloped hammerhead swims close by!
text.bite: A scalloped hammerhead bumped you! Keep swimming!
text.menu_sub: Cruise over the reef, look for small fish, rest in warm shallow bays.
text.menu_wild: You are big and strong. Little fish hide when you swim near.
text.intro: Up and Down to swim deeper. Swim slowly and look for food!
text.safe_tag: Tag, you got it! In Safe mode a hammerhead never goes hungry.
text.hungry: You are hungry. Swim over the reef and look for food!
text.no_food: No food here. Swim to another part of the reef.
text.about_looks: Grey-brown on top and white below, with a wide hammer head that has a scalloped front edge and a dent in the middle.
text.about_food: Small schooling fish like sardines, and also squid, octopus and shrimp.
text.about_home: Lives in warm seas near reefs and in open blue water. Pups and young sharks stay in shallow bays and mangroves.
text.about_winter: Keeps swimming all year. The water stays warm, so it swims and eats all the time.
text.about_young: Pups are born live in the warm season. A mother has twelve to forty-one pups and they swim on their own.
text.about_fact: Its wide hammer head helps it see and smell all around.

year.shelter: Pups and young sharks stay in shallow bays and mangroves. Adults cruise over reefs and open blue water.
year.young: Pups are born live in the warm season. A mother has twelve to forty-one pups.

food.spring: Schooling fish like sardines, and squid, octopus and shrimp. More squid in deep water at night.
